intro.summary: A novena honoring the Infant Jesus of Prague, a devotion centered on the Christ Child and seeking His help through prayer and trust.

blocks.text: You can pray the full Infant of Prague Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. O Jesus, who has said, “Ask and you shall receive, seek and you shall find, knock and it shall be opened to you,” through the intercession of Mary, Your Most Holy Mother, I knock, I seek, and I ask that my prayer may be granted.

O Jesus, who has said, “All that you ask of the Father in My Name, He will grant you,” through the intercession of Mary, Your Most Holy Mother, I humbly and urgently ask Your Father in Thy Name, that my prayer be granted.

O Jesus, who has said, “Heaven and Earth shall pass away, but My word shall not pass,” through the intercession of Mary, Your Most Holy Mother, I place my confidence in You that my prayer will be granted.

Divine Infant Jesus, I know You love me and would never leave me. I thank You for Your close presence in my life. Miraculous Infant, I believe in Your promise of peace, blessings, and freedom from want. I place every need and care in Your hands. Lord Jesus, may I always trust in Your generous mercy and love. I want to honor and praise You, now and forever. Amen. Infant of Prague, have mercy on us. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
